name: Slithermuse
oracle_text:
When this creature leaves the battlefield, choose an opponent. If that player has more cards in hand than you, draw cards equal to the difference.
Evoke {3}{U} (You may cast this spell for its evoke cost. If you do, it's sacrificed when it enters.)
blocked_sentences: Evoke {3}{U} (You may cast this spell for its evoke cost. If you do, it's sacrificed when it enters.)

needs.what: an evoke cost whose mana value equals the printed cost but whose colored requirement differs: printed {2}{U}{U}, evoke {3}{U} (one fewer blue pip), sacrificed on entering when evoked
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The card-level 'evoke' key is the right mechanism, but the loader (cards/loader/__init__.py, the evoke guard) rejects any evoke whose mana_value() equals the printed cost's as 'the same cast offered twice'; it compares mana value only, not the symbols, so {3}{U} vs {2}{U}{U} is refused. 'alternative_cost' with mana only requires a condition and is not read by 'evoked'. The guard should compare the parsed costs (symbols), not their mana value. The leaves-the-battlefield line itself is expressible (leaves_battlefield trigger, choose_player each_opponent, if cmp cards_in_hand, draw minus).
